author: Life of Boris
description:
For years, I thought I knew what had gone wrong with my YouTube channel.

I blamed the algorithm.
I blamed changing trends.
I blamed just about everything.

Then I looked back through my own videos and realised I had been asking the wrong question all along.

This isn't a guide on how to grow a YouTube channel.

It's the story of how I finally figured out what was really holding me back.

Thanks for watching.
-Boris
